About Us

About Samridhi Gold Buyers, Greater Noida West

Samridhi Gold Buyers is a gold buying store at Shop No. GF-04, Gaur City Centre, Gaur Chowk, Sector 4, Greater Noida West, Greater Noida, where you can sell gold, silver, diamond jewellery and coins with complete transparency.

We started with a simple observation: most people who sell old gold have no way of knowing whether they are getting a fair price. Traditional testing methods — acid or touchstone — scratch the jewellery, and the final number is often just "trust us". Stones, wastage and melting charges quietly eat into the value.

At Samridhi, the process happens in front of you. We test purity with German XRF Karatmeter technology — the result shows on a screen, live, with zero damage to your jewellery. We weigh your item in front of you, apply the day's live market rate, and explain the full calculation before you decide. Every sale is completed with digital KYC and a proper invoice, and payment is made instantly by cash, NEFT or RTGS.

Our store sits inside Gaur City Centre at Gaur Chowk — a safe, easy-to-reach location for customers from Gaur City, Greater Noida West, Noida Extension, Crossing Republik and Noida. We are open 7 days a week, and testing and valuation are always free.

Our Promise

  • Your jewellery is never damaged during testing — no acid, no scratching, no melting.
  • You see the purity, the weight and the rate. Nothing is hidden.
  • No obligation: if the offer doesn't suit you, you take your jewellery back — free of charge.
  • Instant payment and a proper invoice, every single time.
